rows.text: A message dated 7 May 1995 to M. Jacques Chirac congratulates him on his election to the Presidency of the Republic and says that, once they have agreed on it, the writer will receive him 'avec la déférence que tout citoyen doit au chef de l'Etat'.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-23 only (Président de la République, 1 January 1990 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff).
